responsibility: This implementation module provides the runtime logic for Logitech-compatible bitwise operations on arbitrary memory blocks in GNU Modula-2. It consumes raw addresses and byte counts, uses SYSTEM bitset views together with Builtins memmove/memset to update storage in place, implements blockwise AND/OR/XOR/NOT and byte-sequence shifts across block boundaries, and serves as the block-level companion to the byte- and word-oriented bit utility modules; the advertised rotate operations are present as stubs that currently halt.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of BitBlockOps: unlike BitBlockOps.def, it contains the executable block-wide logic using BITSET/BITSET8 plus memmove/memset, and it reveals that BlockRor and BlockRol are present but not yet implemented.
